hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty' | { read -r skill; if [ "$skill" = "code-review" ]; then git rev-parse HEAD > .git/last-code-review-sha; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|]) *(git[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create)'; then current=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); marker=$(cat .git/last-code-review-sha 2>/dev/null); if [ "$current" != "$marker" ]; then jq -cn --arg sha "$current" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow",permissionDecisionReason:("Reminder: /code-review has not been run for the current commit (" + $sha + "). Run /code-review and address findings before this push/PR (CLAUDE.md workflow step 6).")}}'; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
